verdict.rationale: Factory is primarily an agent (Droid) whose docs mostly describe connecting to external MCP tools as a client (factory-docs-4, factory-docs-26), which alone would be na for this story. However, a specific probe indicates an official MCP server page at docs.factory.ai/harness/mcp (factory-probe-3), suggesting Factory's harness may expose an MCP server, which flips the axis to applicable. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the MCP server's endpoint, tool exposure, and any independent confirmation that other agents can connect to it.
